workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description:
This is the final working week of the cycle. At this point we have completed 3 full cycles of the strength and endurance phase. We have slowly progressed to heavier intensity loads, heavier volume loads, and faster speeds. If you have made it to this point, congratulations, although this cycle has been pretty fun, it’s also a big grind and takes a lot of grit to get through.

You can look forward to a deload week next week followed by a testing week to conclude the phase.

But first, have fun with the final training week.
